description.la: Allegorica expositio in Canticum Habacuc prophetae.
description.en-US: Bede's short allegorical commentary on the prayer of Habakkuk (Hab 3), sung in the Church's office. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: O breve comentário alegórico de Beda à oração de Habacuc (Hab 3), cantada no ofício da Igreja.

sources.edition: Allegorica expositio in Canticum Habacuc on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
